payload.summary: The record of the one thing anybody argued about. Officers took members through the five proposed changes and told them 72 responses had come in. The committee suggested no changes to the proposals, then by a majority vote asked Cabinet to consider removing a rule the officers had not proposed touching — paragraph 3.8.7.3, which withholds extra priority from families in a flat with no garden where the children were born after the family moved in. Members also asked for more about the council's assessment panel to be written into the policy, and for research on co-parenting in council homes to come back to a later meeting.
